cohort: 150 patients with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) who underwent elective pre-labor cesarean deliveries.
finding: The study identified Gram-negative bacteria, primarily E. coli, as the main microbial etiology for surgical site infections (SSIs) in GDM cesarean patients, with significant antibiotic resistance, and highlighted operation time >=1-hour, amniotic fluid contamination, genital tract inflammation, and elevated PCT and HbA1c as significant risk factors.
